headline: Portfolio Outperforms SPY YTD
summary: As of September 25, 2026, the portfolio has delivered an average return of 28.39%, significantly outperforming the SPY benchmark return of 13.83%. This performance translates to an average alpha of 14.56%, indicating that the portfolio is not only gaining in absolute terms but is also ahead of the broader market. The top portfolio, 'Random A', has achieved a remarkable return of 47.42%, contributing positively to the overall performance. In contrast, the weakest portfolio, 'Random B', has returned 10.91%, which still reflects a positive outcome relative to SPY. This outperformance is particularly relevant during periods of market uncertainty, showcasing the portfolio's resilience against broader market movements. Note: Updated 30 minutes before and after market close.
